Name: Enhanced Phantom Guard
Description: Improves Phantom Guard's damage reduction effect to 90%.

Name: Enhanced Pray
Description: Increases the healing potency of Pray to 5,000.

Name: Enhanced Rage
Description: Grants the effect of Pent-up Rage, increasing the potency of Deadly Blow based on the amount of damage you have taken while the effect is active. Duration: 15s

Name: Enhanced Phantom Kick
Description: Improves Phantom Kick's damage increase to 7%.

Name: Enhanced Phantom Kick II
Description: Improves Phantom Kick's damage increase to 9%.

Name: Enhanced Phantom Aim
Description: Improves Phantom Aim's critical hit rate and direct hit rate increase to 30%, and guarantees all attacks land.

Name: Enhanced Phantom Aim II
Description: Improves Phantom Aim's critical hit rate and direct hit rate increase to 50%, and guarantees all attacks land.

Name: Enhanced Iainuki
Description: Increases the potency of Iainuki to 500, and increases chance to instantly kill target to 10%.

Name: Enhanced Vocals
Description: Increases the effectiveness of songs in accordance with your Phantom Bard level.

Name: Lockpicker
Description: Allows you to open locked doors in dungeons.

Name: Enhanced Phantom Fire
Description: Grants a 5% chance to instantly kill targets when executing Phantom Fire, with some exceptions.

Name: Enhanced Bell
Description: Increases the effectiveness of Battle Bell to 5%, and increases the healing potency of Ringing Respite to 3,000.

Name: First Strike
Description: Grants First Strike when entering combat. First Strike Effect: Weaponskill cast time and recast time, spell cast time and recast time, and auto-attack delay are reduced Duration: 25s

Name: Enhanced Occult Jump
Description: Increases potency of Occult Jump to 500, and increases potency of reduced damage taken effect to 90%.

Name: Occult Learning I
Description: Occult Missile and Occult Aqua Breath are now learnable actions. Missile Effect: Delivers an attack with a 35% chance to deal damage equal to 75% of target's current HP, with some exceptions Occult Aqua Breath Effect: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it

Name: Occult Learning II
Description: Occult Aero II and Occult Mighty Guard are now learnable actions. Occult Aero II Effect: Deals wind damage to target Occult Mighty Guard Effect: Reduces damage taken by self and nearby party members by 20%

Name: Occult Learning III
Description: Occult White Wind is now a learnable action. Occult White Wind Effect: Restores own HP and the HP of all nearby party members by an amount equal to your current HP If Occult Aero II has already been learned, Occult Aero III can also be learned. Occult Aero III Effect: Deals wind damage to target and all enemies nearby it

Name: Dualcast
Description: Grants the effect of Dualcast upon casting any spell with a cast time. While under the effect of Dualcast, your next spell will require no time to cast. Effect is canceled upon execution of any action other than an ability. Auto-attacks do not cancel effect. Duration: 15s

Name: Adaptable
Description: Allows the changing of phantom jobs when normally prohibited, as well as during combat.
